entries.title: Genesis 37:1
segments: ¶And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan. {wherein...: Heb. of his father's sojournings}

entries.title: Genesis 37:2
segments: These [are] the generations of Jacob. Joseph, [being] seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad [was] with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

entries.title: Genesis 37:3
segments: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he [was] the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of [many] colours. {colours: or, pieces}

entries.title: Genesis 37:4
segments: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

words.text: him more than all his brethren

entries.title: Genesis 37:5
segments: ¶And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told [it] his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

entries.title: Genesis 37:6
segments: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

entries.title: Genesis 37:7
segments: For, behold, we [were] binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

entries.title: Genesis 37:8
segments: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

words.text: over us? or shalt thou indeed

entries.title: Genesis 37:9
segments: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

entries.title: Genesis 37:10
segments: And he told [it] to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What [is] this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

words.text: ourselves to thee to the earth

entries.title: Genesis 37:11
segments: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

entries.title: Genesis 37:12
segments: ¶And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 37:13
segments: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed [the flock] in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here [am I].

entries.title: Genesis 37:14
segments: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem. {see...: Heb. see the peace of thy brethren, etc.}

words.text: . {see...: Heb. see the peace of thy brethren, etc.}

entries.title: Genesis 37:15
segments: And a certain man found him, and, behold, [he was] wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

entries.title: Genesis 37:16
segments: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed [their flocks].

entries.title: Genesis 37:17
segments: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

entries.title: Genesis 37:18
segments: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

entries.title: Genesis 37:19
segments: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh. {dreamer: Heb. master of dreams}

entries.title: Genesis 37:20
segments: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

words.text: now therefore, and let us slay
what will become of his dreams

entries.title: Genesis 37:21
segments: And Reuben heard [it], and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

entries.title: Genesis 37:22
segments: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, [but] cast him into this pit that [is] in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

words.text: upon him; that he might rid

entries.title: Genesis 37:23
segments: ¶And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, [his] coat of [many] colours that [was] on him; {colours: or, pieces}

words.text: ¶And it came to pass, when Joseph

entries.title: Genesis 37:24
segments: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit [was] empty, [there was] no water in it.

entries.title: Genesis 37:25
segments: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry [it] down to Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 37:26
segments: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit [is it] if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

entries.title: Genesis 37:27
segments: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he [is] our brother [and] our flesh. And his brethren were content. {were...: Heb. hearkened}

words.text: be upon him; for he [is] our brother

entries.title: Genesis 37:28
segments: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty [pieces] of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 37:29
segments: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph [was] not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

entries.title: Genesis 37:30
segments: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child [is] not; and I, whither shall I go?

entries.title: Genesis 37:31
segments: ¶And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

entries.title: Genesis 37:32
segments: And they sent the coat of [many] colours, and they brought [it] to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it [be] thy son's coat or no.

entries.title: Genesis 37:33
segments: And he knew it, and said, [It is] my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

entries.title: Genesis 37:34
segments: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

entries.title: Genesis 37:35
segments: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

entries.title: Genesis 37:36
segments: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, [and] captain of the guard. {officer: Heb. eunuch: but the word doth signify not only eunuchs, but also chamberlains, courtiers, and officers} {captain...: or, chief marshal: Heb. chief of the slaughter men, or executioners}
